question: What certain outcome results when a disease-afflicted condition persists over time?
premises: A condition can be afflicted by disease.
Time can pass without effective intervention.
An affliction may progress beyond control.
inference: A disease-afflicted condition will certainly become unmanageable over time.
uncertainties: The implied subject of pīḍitaṃ and avidheyaṃ is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: Afflicted by disease, it would certainly become unmanageable over time.
